name: WiFi (QCA6390 on PCIe, cnss2) - EXPERIMENTAL
description: QCA6390 on PCIe: the cnss2 + qcacld (wlan.ko) host driver downloads amss.bin, m3.bin and the board data (bdwlan) from the modem partition (mounted in pre-init before the modules load) and creates wlan0, which HarmonyOS's WiFi HDI uses directly. EXPERIMENTAL: keep 'Remove setup wizard' on until WiFi is confirmed working.
